contact_edits.before: The production gets in nearly every syllable of text, and has thought about every one of them. As a Soulpepper show, it's on par with Laszlo Marton's Chekhovs --and more like them than you might imagine. - The Way of the World runs through Aug. 2 at the Young Centre; 416-866-8666.
